dct_title_s: Street Median Strips - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains road median strips and other open areas in street rights-of-way.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to transportation analysis and planning as well as more advanced user applications such as urban planning and policy, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: The City of Newton maintains this data layer as needed.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
Data credit: GIS data supplied by City of Newton GIS.
